status: source-confirmed; implementation and all runtime verification pending
scope: Credential-bearing Network request URL values entering a saved matcher and default name; no D47 tap timing or document-provenance change
source_reproduction: Capture and select a synthetic GET https://calendar.invalid/api/events?date=2026-09-27&access_token=SYNTHETIC_SECRET&page=2.
NetworkTab copies event.url into replayUrlFilter and defaultName. SaveAsPattern forwards the config and name into savePattern, which inserts them into extend.wbx_pattern without URL sanitization.

runNetworkCapturePattern then exact-matches the raw saved URL and uses raw event.url for ambiguity identity; a rotated access_token produces no match, while a broad matcher can call rotated credentials different identities.
existing_primitives_and_siblings: src/lib/credentials/login-urls.ts normalizes credential-login destinations by dropping all query/hash; its safe destination policy is valuable, but its normalization would erase ordinary Network date/page identity and must not be reused verbatim.

src/lib/desktop/ws-client.ts and ws-offscreen.ts each contain a local redactToken helper that only masks one token query value in log strings; neither protects saved Network config or name. Converge these on a shared URL sanitizer where feasible.

src/lib/tools/handlers/data-patterns.ts is another network_capture save caller through the same generic savePattern sink; src/features/data/DataView.tsx saves manual_css only. The sink must sanitize network_capture regardless of which caller supplies it.
The capture event and response body remain transient by design. Do not treat masking the NetworkTab display alone as persistence protection.
recommended_design: Create one pure credential-aware URL canonicalizer under src/lib/credentials/ for request URL display, save, replay matching, and diagnostic strings. Recognize case/encoding variants of token, access_token, api_key/apikey, secret, password, authorization, signature, session/JWT and related credential query keys; remove URL userinfo and fragment. Preserve unrelated query keys and values and their exact matching behavior.

At NetworkTab selection, prefill a sanitized matcher and derive a sanitized default name and visible URL labels. At savePattern, sanitize network_capture config.url_filter and name again so Showcase and agent-save callers cannot bypass the sink. Do not persist the captured raw URL in a new side field.

For exact and intentional partial/wildcard matching, compare canonicalized candidate URL and canonicalized filter. A detected credential key remains required but its value is a wildcard; ordinary date/page values remain exact. Use the same canonical URL inside runNetworkCapturePattern's ambiguity identity so rotation alone does not create a false distinct request.

Keep explicit broad-match warnings and body/method identity checks; when credential keys rotate, replay may select the newest matching successful response only if all remaining request identity is unambiguous. Never log the raw URL in errors or progress.

Unknown credential parameter names cannot be proven safe by a finite key list. The save UI should disclose masked keys and offer a per-query-key 'Treat as credential' choice; a strict no-raw-value guarantee for arbitrary unknown keys would require storing ordinary-value digests instead of literal query values and merits an explicit follow-up design decision. Do not claim the finite classifier provides that guarantee.
proposed_file_ownership: src/lib/credentials/credential-url.ts (shared pure sanitizer and matcher canonical form)
src/features/showcase/tabs/NetworkTab.tsx (safe default URL/name and clear matcher guidance)
src/lib/data-pattern/run-interactive.ts (canonical match, ambiguity identity, safe errors only; no D47 timing changes)
src/lib/desktop/ws-client.ts and ws-offscreen.ts (replace narrow duplicate log redactors if shared helper preserves their behavior)
regression_scope: Real NetworkTab select→SaveAsPattern→savePattern argument with synthetic access_token/api_key/signature values; asserts no value in persisted name/config while date/page stay exact, rotated credential matches, different ordinary date does not, and the interactive runner returns only the intended rows. The pending test is not in discovery and has not run red.
verification_required: After sole guarded permit, run the intended red assertions first, implement, run focused green plus ordinary query identity and D41 replay siblings, compile, then installed-extension real-site capture/save/reopen/replay. Inspect the actual stored network_capture config/name without exposing credentials in logs. Existing historical saved rows are outside this no-DB-change task and require separate hygiene assessment.
